methodologyNotes: Dataset covers 11 wood pellet grill models spanning entry-level portables to premium competition units. Primary sources are manufacturer product pages (traeger.com, campchef.com, yodersmokers.com, greenmountaingrills.com, zgrills.com, pitboss-grills.com) supplemented by retailer listings (BBQGuys, Lowe's, Home Depot, atbbq.com) and long-form review sites (smokedbbqsource.com, heygrillhey.com, derrickriches.com). Cooking area figures are total square inches (primary plus secondary/warming racks combined where that is how the manufacturer reports); booleans are true where the manufacturer explicitly states WiFi or PID; priceUsd is published US MSRP or official website list price at time of access. Adversarial re-verification 2026-06-19 corrected three records: GMG Trek Prime 2.0 cooking area (219->274) and hopper (9->10); Camp Chef SmokePro DLX (incorrectly flagged discontinued in draft — it is actively sold, MSRP restored to 699 and weight corrected 113->140); all prices and headline specs re-confirmed against primary or reputable retail sources. accessedAt 2026-06-19.
